title: Global phage therapy research funding, 1999–2023: code, aggregate data and documentation
description: Code, aggregate tables and documentation for the study Twenty-five years of phage therapy funding: rapid growth, narrow base. The analysis covers 802 phage therapy research grants with a recorded amount (USD 318.6 million, 1999–2023) from a Dimensions search of 13 February 2024. The release contains the tables behind every figure and number in the paper, the data behind the interactive explorer (https://cognosx.ca/phage-funding), a data dictionary, a datasheet and a Frictionless data package. Grant-level records and researcher names are not included. Data: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT.
